about.title: About Me
about.whoIAmText: I'm a Data Science student and product-minded builder, working between N'Djamena and Kigali. Curious, resourceful and detail-oriented, I care about clarity, usability and a smooth experience for real users.
about.whatIDoText: I build web platforms, mobile apps and machine-learning tools — taking an idea from raw data and a rough design through to something people can actually use. I iterate quickly, ship frequently, and validate with working prototypes rather than plans.
about.myMissionText: Build digital products that genuinely serve students and entrepreneurs across Africa — scalable, reliable and simple to use. I'm driven by impact and continuous improvement.
about.statement: I take an idea from raw data and a rough design through to something people can actually use. I iterate quickly, ship often, and prove things with working prototypes rather than plans.
